entries.22fdbc3c1bc358e5: It is a reportable segment that plans, develops and operates games and tool applications under the theme of 'realizing connections between people'. It mainly provides in-house developed game apps for smart devices to the world through distribution platforms. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥3,858 million.
entries.2636d16637e3542a: It is a reportable segment that plans, develops and operates comparison sites, information media and tools closely tied to everyday life, and provides business support for digital customer acquisition for corporate clients. It operates comparison sites such as Hikkoshi Samurai, Nabikuru and Hanayume, the engineer community 'Qiita', and the headless CMS 'microCMS', among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥16,192 million.
entries.52863a8a8ddff70f: A pure holding company that operates comparison sites and information media, operates D2C sites, and plans, develops and operates game apps.
entries.c0277887e0a492fe: It is a pure holding company with its head office in Nakamura-ku, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture. The company and its 12 consolidated subsidiaries make up the group, and as of July 31, 2026, consolidated employees numbered 729. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market.
